prompt:
Answer all questions in one sentence.
From the case study, “Paper or Plastic”: It was widely accepted that paper cups were a more sustainable option than Styrofoam cups. Explain why this might not necessarily be the case.

Explain why only humans generate waste.

What is meant by the waste stream?
judge_reasoning: Candidate [1] is the only response that meaningfully addresses all parts of the prompt: it discusses why paper cups might not be more sustainable, responds to the “only humans generate waste” idea, and defines the “waste stream.” Candidate [2] focuses heavily on the paper-vs-Styrofoam sustainability question but omits the other two requested explanations. Candidate [3] strongly engages with the “only humans generate waste” framing by explaining how non-human animals manage waste, but it does not answer the other prompt parts. Candidate [4] gives a general outline of household waste management stages, which is only indirectly related to “waste stream” and similarly misses the other questions.
